featured_reviews.name: Ajit Ghodke
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently attended the marriage ceremony of a kin.vExcellent ambience, great view of Hiranandani Complex from 8th floor terrace. Plush, well decorated, AC hall for various functions having roughly a capacity of 400 pax. Huge terrace with scenic view for dining, high tea and photography enthusiasts. Food quality is good and service is prompt and polite. Valet parking. Sound services are flawless. The costs are a bit higher than deserved as it is way far off place and not easily accessible. However, there are few things which would have been better such as extra rooms for changing clothes, wide toilet  accommodating wheelchair and with provision of hand rails for differently abled and elderly persons, an intelligent DJ who can pick the nerves of guests and the ambience of the function, bit more efficient circulation of starters and drinks, better signages and accessibility for cabs at the entrance for easy pickup and drop, more accessible washrooms with ramps for easy movement of wheelchairs especially one in terrace area. Overall it is a good place to host  if one is willing to shell off extra bucks for a plush function.

They have two halls so there you  can plan a big event also.
For serving food they have ground floor so the main function and lunch or dinne party can be enjoyed separately.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Parasiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
The hall is good enough to accumulate 500 people at once.
The building is.of 2 floors + ground

All of them can have 500 perople once.

There are extra rooms for which the luggage and you can even rest there.

The washrooms are good enough 7 out of 10

featured_reviews.review_text:
Decorator  Issues

•	Decorator Forgetfulness/Negligence: Despite numerous discussions and reminders, the decorator forgot key entry props and then gave "lame excuses."

•	Hall Maintenance/Ambiance: The overall hall maintenance and ambiance only rated two stars.

Music System and Staff Issues
The person who was briefly managing the music system left/ran away after only half a day.

featured_reviews.name: Sushanth Bangera
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently celebrated my engagement at Antarish in Powai and it was truly a memorable experience. The venue exuded elegance with superb decorations that added a touch of charm to the entire event. The highlight of the event was delicious food ,good ambiance and top notch sound and light system . A huge thank you to Ms Ruchi who helped us manage the event so well. Her professionalism and dedication ensured that every detail was taken care of , making the event a huge success. She was very supportive and attentive and made sure everything went smoothly. Antariksh Banquets proved to be an ideal choice for our engagement. The smooth arrangements and good service made it a truly unforgettable event. I'd highly recommend Antariksh Banquets for any special occasion, especially for those looking for a blend of space, aesthetics, and culinary excellence.
